title: KayKit Adventurers
summary: Five rigged, textured, low-poly fantasy characters by Kay Lousberg (Knight, Barbarian, Mage, Rogue, hooded Rogue) with 76 shared clips, and 27 weapons and props.
useWhen: A stylized fantasy game needs ready, animated heroes, enemies, or NPCs with weapons, such as a dungeon crawler or a tactics game, and modelling, rigging, and animating them would take too long.
avoidWhen: Realistic, modern, or non-human characters, or an art style that the chunky, big-headed look does not match: use universal-base-characters or MPFB, or model them in Blender.
copyright: Characters, clips, and props by Kay Lousberg (www.kaylousberg.com); the import settings that WASD Engine adds are also CC0-1.0
